simple.meaning: שָׂפָה (sâphâh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “the lip (as a natural boundary); by implication, language ; by analogy, a margin (of a vessel, water, cloth, etc.).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 11:1. The background is built from the passages where the word occurs.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שָׂפָה (H8193) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: שָׂפָה (sâphâh) / H8193 is traced through Genesis 11:1, Genesis 11:6, Genesis 11:7, Genesis 11:9 with generated occurrence evidence.

definitions.short: the lip (as a natural boundary); by implication, language ; by analogy, a margin (of a vessel, water, cloth, etc.)
